messages:
marta: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to add a migration guide for semi-airgapped Private deployments over ExpressRoute where customers still need HSM rotations. Need reviewers @kevin and @sara. Key asks: (1) a minimal Go SDK transport proxy example, (2) a systemd unit snippet for the tls-proxy, (3) a short note about PKCS#11 token handle changes during rotation. PR will live under docs/private/migrations.
kevin: Thanks — can you paste the Go snippet inline? also what deps? we should avoid pushing a heavy example.
marta: Sure, here's the minimal Go example we want to include:
```go
// tiny transport chain: TLS proxy -> SDK
client, _ := sdk.NewClient(sdk.Config{Endpoint: "https://localhost:8443", TLSCert: "/etc/redwood/tls.pem"})
resp, _ := client.Generate("hi")
```
Also systemd snippet (keep minimal):
```ini
[Unit]
Description=redwood-tls-proxy
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-proxy --listen 127.0.0.1:8443 --upstream https://kms.internal:443
Restart=on-failure
```
And a short cert-rotation checklist we want in the doc: `1) rotate proxy cert`, `2) wait for rolling restarts`, `3) rotate HSM client certs`, `4) validate PKCS11 slot mapping`.
kevin: Nice. Add a note showing `--insecure-skip-verify=false` usage and an example cert-rotation order. Also call out the env var `REDWOOD_PROXY_BIND=127.0.0.1` so installers don't accidentally bind to 0.0.0.0.
sara: FYI the docs link to the KMS key rotation page is 404 — I opened a quickfix in the PR to point to the new playbook. Also please add a bullet about HSM slot remapping; we've seen failures when token handles change during pkcs11 refresh and apps assume stable handles.
marco: Suggest adding a tiny ascii diagram + a troubleshooting table (error -> first action). I can draft the diagram and the top-3 errors we've seen.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5124 — labels: docs, private, hsm
marta: Thanks — I'll update the PR with the cert rotation paragraph, include the ascii diag and the troubleshooting table. tagging @kevin @sara for review. planning to merge tomorrow after 2 approvals :thumbsup:
kevin: ack, will review today.
sara: ACK, I'll run the example locally against staging tls-proxy and post any feedback.
marco: Added small ascii art to the PR comment (compact, fits on mobile).
marta: Merged after 2 approvals; leaving a follow-up issue for a full network diagram and policy matrix (tracking: #820).
